statement: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to approximately $13 billion, plus or minus $300 million
why: Forward guidance is the vendor's own read on near-term order flow, and a step up from the reported quarter indicates demand it already has visibility on.

impact.mechanism: Sequentially higher revenue guidance reflects booked and expected accelerator and server demand, signaling continued shipment growth into the next quarter.

evidence.excerpt: revenue to be approximately $13 billion, plus or minus $300 million

confidence.basis: Guidance stated verbatim in AMD's own results release; the implied growth rate and full-year 2027 commentary in the document come from secondary summary and are not asserted here.

dispersion: Guidance band of plus or minus $300 million.
